title: Run events v1
description: The data of one server-sent event of GET /runs/{run_id}/events (D6, D12). The SSE event field names the kind: one run event first, one step event per step, one end event last. Field names follow trace.v1 and headers.v1.

run_id.description: Same value as the x-run-id header of the run's calls.

expected_steps.description: Number of calls this task type usually needs (D1); an estimate, so a run may end before or after it.

run.description: Sent first: what the run is.

created_ms.description: Start of the run in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

step.description: One LLM call that answered, with the tools it called and their results.
Same value as the x-step header of the call.

content.description: The reply's text; null when it only called tools.

arguments.description: The call's arguments as JSON, or the raw text when the model wrote invalid JSON.

result.description: What the tool returned, or the error the runtime sent back for an invalid call; null for a call that never ran: final_answer, which ends the run; every call after it, or after the invalid call that hit agent.max_invalid_calls, in the same reply; every call of a reply cut off at model.max_model_len (finish_reason length).

error.description: The error the runtime sent back when it rejected the reply (D10); null otherwise.

end.description: Sent last, once the run is over; the stream closes after it.

elapsed_ms.description: From the start of the run to its last save.
